title: Repository cleanup and portability

absolute_path_audit.note: grep-equivalent scan of every file under code/, __pycache__ excluded.

portability_changes.old: hard-coded raw CSV path and output path
absolute trips and user-features paths; unconditional write

help_stdout_head: Decode the raw Mobike order CSV into a parquet table.
prepare.overwrite_guard_stderr: <repo>\data\trips.parquet exists; use --out for a new file or --force to overwrite

code_changes.what: argparse --raw/--out/--force; raw glob resolution; refuse to overwrite without --force; DATA from lib
code_changes.why: remove the hard-coded desktop input path and the hard-coded output path without changing decoding.

code_changes.what: read trips via DATA; write figure via FIG
read trips via DATA; write user features via DATA; skip an existing output unless --force
code_changes.why: fix the stale output directory and protect existing data.

code_changes.what: ordered 10->95 runner with --dry-run, stop on first non-zero exit, optional --scripts override
code_changes.why: document and enforce the stage order.

notes: data/dist_matrix.npy is reproduced by Euclidean distances in the projected km frame with the diagonal set to 0.35/sqrt(2), exactly as 10_q1_model.py:34-35 generated it. It is not a haversine matrix: haversine on the cell centres differs on the diagonal by 0.2475 km. The task sheet's word 'spherical' therefore describes a different construction; build_dist_matrix.py follows the actual generator so the rebuild is bit-identical.

data/raw/ does not exist in this workspace, so the default --raw glob was exercised only through --help. The verification run passed the existing raw CSV with an explicit --raw value; that path is not stored in code or in this delivery.
The --force overwrite paths of 00_prepare.py and 04_behaviour.py were deliberately not executed, to protect the existing data. Only the refusal path was tested.
03_diag.py's FIG-joined save path was changed but not executed, to avoid overwriting an existing figure; its syntax and the DATA read path were checked separately.
run_all.py was not run end-to-end, because that would rerun Q1-Q5. Only the dry-run order and the stop-on-failure probe were executed.

Portability is still Windows-first. lib.py and several later scripts concatenate paths with backslashes (for example DATA + r'\trips.parquet' or FIG + backslash), which works on Windows but not on POSIX. T015's scope was the absolute-path removal in 00-04; a full os.path.join sweep is a separate change.
trips_check.parquet matches data/trips.parquet in row count and column names, not byte-for-byte; parquet metadata and compression can differ between pyarrow versions.
README.md and DATA.md still mention the old script names; the reviewer owns their wording, and they were not edited.
No git command was run; .git/, .gitignore, .gitattributes, README.md and DATA.md were not modified.
The code/ audit files were included in the absolute-path scan; they contain no matches.
